title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue’s abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Maserati: The Brothers
overview: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

title: DreamQuil
overview: Set in the not so distant future when poor air quality leads to people living mostly virtual lives. Carol is a dissatisfied career mother, struggling to find connection within her marriage to Gary and her child. With the day to day familiarity of their home and lives feeling increasingly claustrophobic, and worried she could be heading towards divorce, Carol leaps at the chance to get her life back on track by signing up for "DreamQuil", an avant-garde digital wellness retreat. When Carol returns home however, she discovers her family has been living with "Carol 2", a robot the corporation sent designed to help in her absence, and things take a mysterious and sinister turn.

title: The Meltdown
overview: 1992, Chile. Inés parents are away on business and she is left in the care of her grandparents, who own a hotel at the foot of a ski resort. Inés befriends Hanna, a European skier who has come to train in Chile. One night, Hanna disappears. The process of her search will unveil a series of hidden situations.

title: Zero A.D.
overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

title: Очень сказочные дела
overview: All the inhabitants of the Far Far Away Kingdom are obsessed with three glorious heroes. Their battles are like rock concerts: they draw crowds of fans, merchandise is sold on every corner, and every child dreams of being like them. Among them is forty-year-old Elemelya, a simple-minded and awkward boy who also happens to be the president of the Three Heroes fan club, which includes three other children. At the royal feast, trying to get closer to his idols, Elemelya accidentally disrupts the knights secret operation to capture Koschey Bedrosovich. Koschey disappears along with the royal daughter. Now Elemelya is despised by everyone: the people, the tsar, his own fan club-but most importantly, he has disappointed his idols. To set things right, Elemelya, along with the chatty gusli player Alyoshka, sets off on a long journey to Koshchey's underbelly.

title: November 1963
overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

title: Adult Supervision
overview: Three fathers accompany their teenage daughters on a school trip to a remote island. What begins as a peaceful getaway soon turns into a series of unexpected problems. Each father has a different approach to parenting, influenced by his own past experiences, and their conflicting views create tension among them. As the situation becomes increasingly difficult to control, memories of their past return and force them to confront their mistakes and shortcomings. The trip ultimately leaves them questioning who is really in control.

title: INK
overview: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

title: Падший
overview: Geneticist Ivan Rozin, unable to come to terms with the loss of his beloved mother, is obsessively working on a scientific project to find a cure for death and improve the human genome. Violating more and more ethical norms, a scientist absorbed in this idea kidnaps two children. Their mother will have to stop Ivan and prove that his experiments do not lead to perfection, but to the loss of humanity by himself.

title: The Caged
overview: A family is terrorised by a dark presence after they move into a quaint cottage, and discover it lies on the site of a medieval prison which once housed women accused of witchcraft.

title: Три кота. Вокруг света
overview: Continuation of the adventures of Korzhik, Karamelka and Kompot.

title: Winter in Prostokvashino
overview: Sequel to feature film adaptation of "Prostokvashino" by K.B.A.

title: The Debut
overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.
